newsitem.title: USA: US wants strong dlr but not stronger dlr - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: US wants strong dlr but not stronger dlr - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said Sunday that the United States was interested in a strong dollar but not in a stronger dollar.

Talking to reporters after the meeting of Group of Seven finance ministers and central bankers, Tietmeyer said it was the common view that further currency movements, like those seen in recent weeks, would not be in line with economic fundamentals.

"That means that the United States are very much interested in having a strong dollar but not a stronger one," he said. "And we are very much interested in having a strong DM (Deutschemark) but not a weaker one."
